description: Bubblewrap sandbox backend for PenguinHarness: filesystem confinement plus network isolation and path masking.

name: @prismshadow/penguin-plugin-sandbox-seatbelt
description: macOS Seatbelt sandbox backend for PenguinHarness: filesystem confinement plus network isolation and path masking.

description: WSL sandbox backend for PenguinHarness on Windows: commands run in a dedicated WSL2 distro under bubblewrap, with Windows interop switched off.

description: DeepSeek Harness sandbox adaptor for PenguinHarness: the DSH local backend chain behind the harness's own sandbox interface.

description: Claude Code as a session surface for PenguinHarness: a New chat entry that opens the Claude Code TUI in the Session's Workspace.

description: A Discord bot that starts PenguinHarness agents from chat: configure it in a Project's .project_config.toml, message the bot, and a Session opens on that Project's Agent and answers in the same channel.
